stem: The warehouse host exposes inventory and route tools through a standardized tool protocol. What is the main value of protocol-level discovery?

options.text: The model can discover structured tool capabilities and schemas instead of relying on undocumented assumptions

The protocol replaces all tool-result validation
The protocol forces the model to call every available tool
